questions_ray_would_love: Patek confirmed the Nautilus 50th at W&W: three limited editions (5,100 total wristwatch pieces) + a 100-piece pocket watch. White gold and platinum. No titanium anywhere in the lineup. The titanium high alert can stand down for 2026. The 5610/1P (38mm platinum, 2,000 pieces, CHF 90K) is the one to track if you're interested — smallest, most precious, most wearable.

Your AI citation strategy just got more interesting. Perplexity now has 100M+ users (243% YoY) and cites Reddit content in 6.6-46.5% of answers. Your 600+ articles are invisible there. Meanwhile, adding source citations to your articles — which your research pipeline already produces — gives a 115.1% AI visibility boost. FAQ schema adds a 3.2x multiplier. I have a 3-phase plan: Phase 1 (schema + FAQ, I do it, 16 hours) + Phase 2 (source citations in article templates, I do it) + Phase 3 (Reddit/Wikipedia seeding, your call). Phases 1+2 are mechanical. Say 'do it.'

Apple's 4 smart glasses frame styles are confirmed in premium acetate. They're attacking on materials luxury while your team attacks on comfort. Acetate is ~10-15% heavier than polycarbonate — bad for 16-hour prescription wear, good for fashion perception. Your 'Fit to forget' positioning becomes segment-dependent: unbeatable for prescription (where comfort wins), vulnerable for non-prescription (where Apple's material story lands).
